extracted.intended_audience: consumers/cut-the-cord viewers comparing live TV streaming services (people shopping for Hulu + Live TV)
extracted.subtask_description: A consumer-focused review evaluating Hulu + Live TV’s price, channel lineup, sports coverage, DVR and streaming features, device support and user experience to help readers decide if the service fits their needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Price and plan tiers
rubrics_metrics.description: The service’s monthly cost and what each bundle includes (e.g., $88.99–$99.99/mo. depending on whether Hulu/Disney+/ESPN Select and ad-levels are bundled).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare standard monthly price (not promotional) and whether on-demand Hulu, Disney+, or ESPN Select are included; account for add-ons and the separate cost of high-speed internet when judging value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Channel count and lineup quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Total channels offered (95+), and whether the roster avoids filler channels — not just a raw count but whether the lineup is well-rounded across sports, news and family programming.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess both quantity (channels number) and quality/relevance for your needs; a lower count can be acceptable if unnecessary filler is absent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Missing high-profile channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Notable channels absent from the base plan or any add-on (examples: AMC, BBC America, IFC, NBA TV, Sundance TV, YES Network).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify must-have channels for the user; if any missing channels are deal-breakers, consider competitors (YouTube TV, DIRECTV Stream, fuboTV).

rubrics_metrics.name: Add-ons and premium channel pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: Available add-on packages and premium channels with their monthly prices (e.g., Sports add-on $9.99, ESPN Unlimited $29.99, HBO With Ads $9.99/$16.99 No Ads, STARZ $10.99, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculate total monthly cost after adding desired packages; note that add-ons can substantially raise the overall price and change value comparisons vs competitors or cable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Live sports coverage (national and local)
rubrics_metrics.description: Extent of coverage for nationally televised games and local team games; strong on college football/basketball but missing some league-specific channels (e.g., NBA TV) and the Pac-12 Network.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate presence of national broadcasters (ESPN, FOX, NBC, CBS) and conference/team channels relevant to the viewer; missing league or conference channels may be critical for diehard fans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional Sports Network (RSN) availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether local RSNs that carry every MLB/NBA/NHL game for local teams are included — varies by ZIP code (use Hulu’s lookup).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check ZIP code-specific RSN inclusion; lack of RSN access is a common difference across platforms and can determine whether a service covers your local teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cloud DVR storage and recording rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Cloud DVR features: unlimited cloud DVR storage; recordings expire after nine months or if the account is canceled/past due.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider retention limits (nine months) and the practical value of 'unlimited' when recordings eventually expire; evaluate ability to skip ads in DVR recordings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ad-skipping and fast-forwarding behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: You cannot fast-forward through commercials on live TV or on-demand content; you can fast-forward and skip ads on programs recorded to the Cloud DVR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Factor in advertising experience differences between live/on-demand vs DVR recordings when judging usability and viewing convenience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simultaneous streams and upgrade options
rubrics_metrics.description: Default simultaneous streams: two devices at once; option to add unlimited screens (in the same home) for $9.99/mo.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decide whether the baseline two streams meet household needs or whether the unlimited-screens upgrade is worth the extra cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: User interface and navigation quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Ease of finding live TV content in the app (examples: cumbersome navigation to Live TV, limited channel guide showing only ~4 channels and one time slot at once).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Test the interface on the devices you’ll use; note that mobile apps may offer a better browsing experience than streaming-device apps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Device compatibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Supported streaming devices and platforms (Amazon Fire TV; Android, LG and Samsung smart TVs; Apple TV; Google Chromecast; Roku; Nintendo Switch; PlayStation 4; Xbox One/360).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify your specific device is supported and whether features differ across platforms (e.g., guide behavior, playback controls).

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet speed requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu recommends at least 8 Mbps for live TV and 16 Mbps for 4K content; bandwidth needs increase with each additional device using the connection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure available household bandwidth can support the desired number of simultaneous streams and any 4K watching.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local channel availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of major local broadcast networks (ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, PBS, The CW) in many markets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm local channel availability via ZIP code lookup; local channels can also be obtained via antenna or other free streaming services in some markets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value comparison to competitors and cable
rubrics_metrics.description: Compare price, channel selection, lack of equipment/contracts and overall satisfaction vs cable and other streaming services (YouTube TV, fuboTV, Sling, Xfinity, Spectrum).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When judging 'worth', weigh potential cost savings, channel needs, equipment/installation fees, contract terms, and reported customer satisfaction; include internet cost when comparing to cable bundles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contract length and extra fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu + Live TV is month-to-month (one month contract), with no equipment rental fees; competitors or cable bundles may have installation or equipment charges and longer contract terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include contract flexibility and potential ancillary fees (installation, equipment rental) when assessing total cost and convenience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience-fit recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical guidance on who the service is best for (e.g., great for live sports and family programming, good if you want Hulu on-demand included; not ideal if you require certain missing channels).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Match personal preferences (favorite teams, must-have channels, DVR habits, number of simultaneous viewers) to the service’s strengths and weaknesses to decide suitability.
